name: Agent Zero
install_cmd: if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ERROR: Docker is not installed. Install Docker on the host, then run this deployment again.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then DKR='docker'; elif sudo -n docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then DKR='sudo -n docker'; else echo 'ERROR: Docker daemon is unavailable, or the WebConsole account has no Docker permission/passwordless sudo.' >&2; exit 1; fi; $DKR pull agent0ai/agent-zero:latest; $DKR volume create a0_usr >/dev/null; $DKR rm -f agent-zero >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; $DKR create --name agent-zero --restart unless-stopped --add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway --ulimit nofile=65535:65535 -p "${AGENT_ZERO_PORT:-50080}:80" -v a0_usr:/a0/usr agent0ai/agent-zero:latest >/dev/null; echo 'Agent Zero container was created successfully; WebConsole will start it automatically.'
start_cmd: if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then DKR='docker'; elif sudo -n docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then DKR='sudo -n docker'; else echo 'ERROR: Docker is unavailable.' >&2; exit 1; fi; cleanup(){ $DKR stop -t 2 agent-zero >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT TERM INT; $DKR start agent-zero >/dev/null; $DKR logs -f --tail 200 agent-zero & LOG_PID=$!; $DKR wait agent-zero >/dev/null & WAIT_PID=$!; wait "$WAIT_PID"; RC=$?; kill "$LOG_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$LOG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; exit "$RC"
